registryBasis: Florianópolis municipal materials describe GeoFloripa as the city’s internal multipurpose territorial-cadastre system and GeoPortal as the public IDE with interactive maps, geoservices, metadata, and downloads. The official city service for georeferencing lots confirms the municipal lot-cartography workflow.

officialSources.observation: Florianópolis municipal materials describe GeoFloripa as the city’s internal multipurpose territorial-cadastre system and GeoPortal as the public IDE with interactive maps, geoservices, metadata, and downloads. The official city service for georeferencing lots confirms the municipal lot-cartography workflow. The GeoPortal offers map-layer exports and downloads, but the material reviewed did not verify the field schema for a parcel layer or an explicit server-side geometry-and-ID-only allowlist. The map includes property-identification and property-document functions; no parcel or coordinate identify request was made.

accessReview.reason: Official GeoPortal documentation publishes the GeoFloripa GeoServer WMS endpoint and identifies the public GeoPortal as a source of downloadable map layers. Anonymous attempts to load WMS GetCapabilities and a WFS DescribeFeatureType request to candidate type Geoportal:lotes_pgv_2023 did not return an HTTP response: the default shell attempt failed DNS resolution and the network-enabled retry timed out after 25 seconds. The web fetcher also marked the endpoint inaccessible. Thus the WMS URL is documented, but layer capabilities, WFS type, DescribeFeatureType fields, CRS, stable parcel ID, and any server-side propertyName allowlist remain unverified. A non-official technical page names lotes_pgv_2023 and indicates cadastral/tax attributes may be present; it is only a lead, not official schema evidence. No GetFeature/identify request or geometry download was made.

requestEvidence.schemaRequestOutcome: No HTTP response; DNS resolution failure on default shell attempt and 25-second connection timeout on network-enabled retry.
requestEvidence.notes: No owner, address, tax-account, title, parcel-number, identify, or person-specific lookup was made. No geometry data was requested or retained.
